model.name: R19.92: In-room file items use the same data path as /trace — not bespoke WS feed.
model.description: The /trace traceability browser renders the room's files perfectly (first two pictures). The in-room file tree does NOT. ROOT CAUSE: in-room uses a bespoke WS feed for file items instead of the same scenario-unit data path that /trace uses. FIX: in-room file items MUST use the SAME data path as /trace — load FileUnit scenario units from the scenario index (Room.files[] IOR → fetch unit → render rb-object-item), not a separate WS message feed. This is the DRY principle from R19.90 applied to the DATA layer, not just the component layer.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "in the first two pictures the files perfectly work. why not IN the rooms the same way... finally fix the in room file items"
model.crossRefNote: R19.90 (reuse rb-trace-tree component) fixed the COMPONENT layer. R19.92 fixes the DATA layer: same scenario-unit fetch path, not bespoke WS. R19.46 (Room.files[] IOR list) is the data source.
